summary: Iteration 10 retest of iteration_9's HIGH priority failing item (edit-mode prefill race) + GO_BACK navigation fixes. ALL 19/19 checks PASSED (mobile viewport 390x844, keuangan@sekolah.id). (1) RACE RETEST (the critical item): delayed GET /api/students/{id} by 6s via page.route interception; typed 'RACE ORTU' (80ms/keystroke) into student-parent-input and '08999' into student-phone-input BEFORE data arrived; when the delayed response resolved, typed text REMAINED untouched (screenshot t2_race_dirty.png). Pristine counterpart also verified: with no user interaction, prefill still fills name/parent/phone from server once data arrives. (2) Add mode: full fill (name, parent, phone, first class chip) -> save -> navigates to detail, student-parent-name='Ibu Test I10' / student-parent-phone='081299988877' shown. (3) Edit save via deep link (page.goto, no history): navigates to /student/{id} detail, ZERO 'GO_BACK was not handled' events in console or dialogs; edit persisted (header title 'TEST_I10 Race Edited'). (4) Delete via deep link: window.confirm auto-accepted, navigates to /siswa, zero GO_BACK events, API GET returns 404. (5) Payment regression: pay-program-* chips present in add mode after class chip selected (count=1), completely absent in edit mode (count=0). GO_BACK events total across the whole session: 0. Cleanup: both test students deleted, API-verified 0 TEST_I10 leftovers.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning persists (carried over from iterations 6-9, still unfixed): '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/ui.tsx (Segmented active item) and other shadow usages.

action_items: Optional (carried over from iter 6-9): migrate deprecated shadow* style props to boxShadow.

Minor design trade-off (by design of the fix, not a bug): if the user types into the edit form BEFORE the student query resolves, prefill is skipped entirely, so fields the user never touched stay empty until manual entry. Acceptable; only relevant on very slow networks.
critical_code_review_comments: student/form.tsx:68-71 — markDirty() sets prefilled.current=true on the FIRST user edit (setField + toggleClass), so the prefill useEffect (lines 42-48) can no longer clobber typed text. Verified empirically with 6s delayed GET /api/students/{id}: typed 'RACE ORTU'/'08999' survived data arrival.
Pristine path still works: without any user interaction, prefill fills all fields once the query resolves (name='TEST_I10 Race', parent='Ibu Asli Race', phone='08111000111').
student/form.tsx:62-63 — save.onSuccess now guards with router.canGoBack(): deep-link edit save uses router.replace(`/student/${s.id}`); 0 GO_BACK errors observed.
student/[id].tsx:54-55 — delete.onSuccess guards with router.canGoBack() and falls back to router.replace('/siswa'); deep-link delete lands on /siswa with 0 GO_BACK errors.
Payment gating `{!id && form.class_ids.length > 0}` (form.tsx:122) re-verified: visible in add mode only.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Race retest technique confirmed working: page.route(re.compile(r'/api/students/[^/?]+$')) with async handler asyncio.sleep(6) then route.continue_(); page.goto full reload resets react-query cache so each delayed load is cold. GO_BACK detection: search page console messages + window dialogs (notify() uses window.alert on web) for 'GO_BACK'. window.confirm must be auto-accepted via page.on('dialog') before clicking delete-student-button. Python <3.12: no backslashes/escaped quotes inside f-string expressions — extract to variables first (browser_automation harness failed on this once). All iteration_9 issues are now RESOLVED.
rca_of_issue: Original bug: edit-mode one-time prefill useEffect overwrote text typed before GET /api/students/{id} resolved (delayed-network race). Fix verified: markDirty() flips prefilled ref to true on first keystroke/chip toggle, so the late prefill is skipped when the form is dirty; pristine forms still get prefilled. Both behaviors verified with a 6s delayed API response. Secondary fix verified: router.canGoBack() guards in student/form.tsx (save) and student/[id].tsx (delete) eliminate the 'GO_BACK was not handled' navigator toast on deep-link entry — 0 occurrences across save and delete flows.
